"Full implementation plan for the Jira adapter.

Extend TicketReferenceSchema...
Architecture proposal f33289bb-d541-49e8-97f9-4fdb494a843a (version 1)

Add Jira support next to Taskbot

When a run starts from a Jira issue, Bob keeps that issue up to date. It moves the status, links the PR and leaves a final comment.

Classification: meaningful

Rationale: Adds a new outside service and a new place to keep secrets.

Decisions:

Where should the Jira code live? Chosen by Bob: Next to the Taskbot code. Same pattern Bob already uses. Trade-off: Bob keeps a small Jira client. Not chosen: Use Atlassian’s MCP server (Less code.; but Everyone must log in through a browser, so background runs break.); A new separate package (Ready for two-way sync later.; but Much more to build than we need now.).
How does Bob pick the right Jira status? Chosen by Bob: You map them once per project. Works even if your team renamed its statuses. Trade-off: A minute of setup. Not chosen: Bob guesses from the names (No setup.; but Quietly breaks when statuses have custom names.).
Should Jira comments reach Bob while it works? OPEN Not chosen: Not yet, add it later (A smaller change now.; but Comments in Jira won’t reach Bob yet.); Yes, in this change (Jira works both ways, like Linear.; but Makes this change about 40% bigger.).

Repository evidence:

bobs-factory: packages/edge-worker/src/factory/TicketTracking.ts. Taskbot and Linear already connect this way. Jira simply becomes the third one.
bobs-factory: packages/edge-worker/src/factory/TicketTracking.ts. Old runs keep working. The change only adds things.

Risks:

The Jira token belongs to one person. If they leave, syncing stops. Bob will show a warning on the run.
Someone may rename a Jira status later. Bob checks the mapping at the start of every run.

What changes:

Start-a-run form (changed, LaunchFields.ts): You can paste a Jira link to start a run.
Settings (new, web/settings.tsx): Where you add your Jira site, token and status mapping.
Ticket tracking (changed, TicketTracking.ts): Picks the right connection for each ticket. Gets one small addition.
Config file (changed, ConfigManager.ts): Holds the Jira token as plain text.
Jira connection (new, JiraAdapter.ts): Moves the issue’s status, links the PR and posts a final comment.
Taskbot link (unchanged, TicketTracking.ts): Existing. Jira will work the same way.
Jira (outside): Atlassian’s Jira Cloud.

Connections: form -> tracking (Jira link); settings -> tracking (mapping); settings -> token (token); tracking -> jiraC; tracking -> taskbotC; token -> jiraC (token); jiraC -> jira"
